_help: Newest first. 'bullets' = the 3 to 5 points always visible. 'more' = extra points behind 'Read more' (delete the key or use [] if none). 'refs' = reference ids from references.json shown as [n] under the role. Percentages stay in projects.json, not here, when a point also appears as a project. Verbs: 'operated' is not 'engineered', 'tested' is not 'implemented'. Keep only what you can defend in an interview.

items.title: DevOps Engineer · Remote
bullets: Operated and scaled AWS infrastructure for 10M+ daily email deliveries through 6x volume growth at 99% uptime.
Sole architect of the SOC 2 Type II technical controls: rewrote 20+ IAM policies, rolled out a company VPN, moved credentials into Secrets Manager.
Led the infrastructure side of a database re-architecture, from tested archival on Citus to an Aurora reader/writer split.
Managed 1,500+ third-party servers for the Smartservers feature and set up the team's on-call process with PagerDuty and NewRelic.
Took customer support tickets every week, was the customers' contact in a shared Slack channel, and linked the Growth and product teams.
more: Built and ran an event-driven pipeline (RDS, SQS, Lambda, ECS) behind the core email-sending workflow, with multi-region connectivity through VPC peering.
Set up disaster-recovery deployments with Terraform and Bitbucket-based infrastructure delivery.
Added container image scanning to the deploy path and worked with external consultants to turn SOC 2 requirements into automated fixes.
Provisioned third-party servers with Cloud-Init scripts that installed Docker, NewRelic logging and firewall rules.
Deployed and customized an open-weight DeepSeek model on EC2 to study its effect on email deliverability.
Joined customer meetings and acted as the link between the Growth team and product managers for services I owned, such as Smartservers.

items.title: DevOps Engineer
bullets: Built development and production AWS environments from scratch with Terraform, aligned with SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
Hardened deployment servers to STIG policies and sandboxed Go services with systemd slices and chroot.
Automated build and deploy pipelines for several customer environments with Ansible, Python/Boto3 and shell scripts.
more: Rolled out Tailscale VPN for service access and onboarded the first user groups.
Ran EC2 instances across several secure VPCs, with VPC peering and cross-region API connectivity.
Collected logs from the systemd slices with rsync into S3 and used ELK for observability.
Used Fossil for version control across the build and deploy setup.

items.title: Site Reliability Engineer · Chennai
bullets: Migrated 25+ applications from OpenStack to AWS in a team of three, cutting latency 15% for downstream teams.
Helped move 30+ microservices from Kops clusters to EKS with Istio and Karpenter, taking deployment time from 12 to 5 hours per sprint.
Led the move of a critical EC2 application from x86 to ARM, and found a five-month API proxy bottleneck with new dashboards and alerts.
Kept CI/CD running across teams with Jenkins, Ansible and SaltStack.
Awards: Spotlight Award (June 2022) and High Five CHAMP Award (June 2023).
more: Provisioned and operated Kafka, OpenSearch and Spark for the migrated applications (operations and provisioning; developers owned the application design).
Ran Kafka, Spark and Cassandra for a Wi-Fi platform serving 1.5M+ users at 99.95% uptime.
Built the staging environment on AWS with EKS and ECR, monitored with Prometheus, ELK and Grafana.
Automated 100+ Icinga alerts, which cut incident response time by half.
Deployed new microservices and patches to pre-production and production, including backend Go services across EC2 and Kubernetes in several regions.

items.title: Software / DevOps Engineer · Pune
bullets: Built a production environment on Google Cloud and an Apigee API gateway for a new project.
Ran CI/CD with Bitbucket Pipelines, Docker and Ansible, and updated Kubernetes microservices every sprint.
Wrote Python tooling for server notifications, including an integration from GCP to Workplace.
more: Managed Kubernetes microservice updates with Ansible and Rancher.
Updated and documented an OpenVPN server running on AWS.
Set up cloud, Kubernetes, Git, Confluence, Jira and database accounts for new joiners.
